fire+water.name: Vaporize
fire+water.description: Explosive steam bursts forth, scorching the target and obstructing their vision.

water+air.name: Freeze
water+air.description: Frigid winds flash-freeze the soaked target, encasing them in solid ice and skipping their turn.

fire+air.name: Conflagration
fire+air.description: Violent air currents fan roaring flames into a raging inferno, inflicting severe burn over time.

earth+fire.name: Magma Melt
earth+fire.description: Scorching magma liquifies defensive carapaces and armor, drastically reducing damage mitigation.

water+earth.name: Mire
water+earth.description: Churning mud and quagmire weigh down the target, heavily penalizing their stamina regeneration.

lust+arcane.name: Enthrall
lust+arcane.description: Lustful psychic resonance captivates the target's psyche, leaving them flustered and disoriented.
